title: Across bridge market selection
description: One direction of one asset between two chains through the pinned Across SpokePools. Bridging back is another market. The amount received is Across's own quote, held under max_fee_bps by the gateway before anything is signed.

chain.description: The source chain, where the deposit is sent.

asset.description: The ERC-20 asset sent from the source chain. The wrapped native asset is refused.

destination_chain.description: The chain the asset arrives on; another chain than the source.

destination_asset.description: The ERC-20 asset received on the destination chain, with the same decimals as the sent asset.

max_fee_bps.description: The most the whole bridge may cost, in basis points of the amount sent. A quote above it is refused before the approval.

quote.description: The one source of the amount received: Across's own quote API. It is named, never defaulted, and nothing substitutes it.
